info.name: AlikoHub Events API
info.description:
# AlikoHub Events API

Role-based collection for the Events domain via the API Gateway.

## Roles
| Role | Token var | Can do |
|------|-----------|--------|
| **Public** | (none) | Browse published feed, promote, RSVP |
| **USER** | `user_token` | Register, view own tickets, self-assign ORGANIZER |
| **CONTENT_MANAGER** | `cm_token` | Create/edit drafts, tickets, sessions, sponsors, submit for review, manage own events |
| **ADMIN** | `admin_token` | Review/publish, users, all promotions, convert promotions |

## Suggested run order
1. **00. Auth** — set `token` (or use debug token locally)
2. **03 CM → Professional Event** — create draft → tickets → submit
3. **05 Admin → Review** — approve/publish
4. **01 Public** — confirm event is live
5. **06 Attendee** — register with ticket
6. **03 CM → Day-of** — check-in + message

## Variables
IDs like `event_id`, `ticket_id`, `registration_id` are auto-saved by test scripts when you run create requests in order.

Local debug: set `token` / `admin_token` to `debug-admin-token`.

item.name: 00. Auth & Token Switch

request.description: Exchange email/password for a Firebase ID token. Copy `idToken` into `token` / role token vars.
Verifies admin token and copies it into `token` for subsequent requests.
Copies `cm_token` → `token`.
Copies `user_token` → `token`.

item.description:
Set which role token is active as `{{token}}`. Collection auth uses `{{token}}` by default.

Local: `debug-admin-token` maps to test-admin-id (usually ADMIN).

item.name: 01. Public (No Auth)

request.description: Only `PUBLISHED` posts. Filter with `type=EVENT|SOCIAL_EVENT|ANNOUNCEMENT|NEWS`.
UUID required. Returns 403 if not PUBLISHED.
Public lead form. Saves `promo_id`.

{
  "companyName": "Acme Corp",
  "contactPerson": "Jane Doe",
  "email": "jane@acme.example",
  "phoneNumber": "+10000000000",
  "organization": "Acme",
  "event_type": "Conference",
  "estimatedAttendees": "200",
  "preferredDate": "2026-09-01T10:00:00.000Z",
  "location": "Addis Ababa",
  "type": "EVENT",
  "message": "We want to host a professional conference with Aliko Events."

exec: if (val) { pm.collectionVariables.set("promo_id", val); console.log("Saved promo_id:", val); }

Anyone. No Bearer required.

item.name: 02. Any Authenticated User

request.description: EventsProfile: id + role (USER | CONTENT_MANAGER | ADMIN).
Same as manage profile; under /events prefix.
Returns `{ userId, role }`.
Self-service. `ORGANIZER` → CONTENT_MANAGER. Cannot self-assign ADMIN. Existing ADMIN is unchanged.
Featured events, announcements, portfolio, counts.
Registrations where I am the attendee.

item.description:
Requires Bearer. Works for USER / CONTENT_MANAGER / ADMIN.

`ORGANIZER` self-assign maps to CONTENT_MANAGER. Admins cannot self-demote via assign-role.

item.name: 03. Content Manager — Professional Event Lifecycle

request.description: Hard delete if unused; soft-deactivates if registrations exist.
Sets isCheckedIn=true.
Idempotent — will not undo a prior check-in.
Author or Admin. targetAudience: ALL | CHECKED_IN | NOT_CHECKED_IN (EVENT).
Real dispatch stats (last 30 days). openRate is null without email webhooks.

item.description:
**Role:** CONTENT_MANAGER or ADMIN (`cm_token`).

### Happy path (run in order)
1. Create EVENT draft → saves `event_id`
2. Add paid + free tickets → `ticket_id` / `free_ticket_id`
3. Add session + sponsor
4. Submit for review → status PENDING
5. (Admin folder) Review APPROVED → becomes PUBLISHED
6. Attendee registers; CM checks in + messages

Only CM/Admin can create professional EVENT/ANNOUNCEMENT/NEWS. Social is separate.

item.description:
**Role:** ADMIN only (`admin_token`).

### Review flow
After CM submits → list PENDING → Review with `PUBLISHED` or `APPROVED` (both go live) or `REJECTED`.

item.name: 06. Attendee — Registration Flow
item.description:
**Role:** any authenticated user (`user_token` or `token`).

If the event has active ticket tiers, `ticketId` is **required**.
- Paid ticket → `paymentStatus: pending`, `totalPaid` = price, no QR yet
- Free ticket → `paymentStatus: paid` + QR
